skills.skill: Decide whether two expressions using any of +, −, × or ÷ are equal in value

misconceptions.pattern: Reads = as 'write the answer' rather than 'same value', so does not evaluate both sides — especially when one side multiplies or divides and the other adds or subtracts.

strategies.intent: Work out the value on each side using its own operation — multiply, divide, add or subtract — then compare the two totals for sameness.
